name: plant-identification-care-app
description: Persian/RTL web app for AI plant identification & care (NestJS + Next.js + Drizzle + Redis/BullMQ).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared --if-present && npm run test --workspace backend --if-present && npm run test --workspace frontend --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:default && npm run test:e2e:low-confidence && npm run test:e2e:ai-failure
